# SIM-EMU

<div className="screenshot">

![SIM-EMU: screenshot 1](./sim-emu/img/sim-emu.png)

</div>

SIM-EMU emulates a SIM card on programmable GreenCard 2, GreenCard, and SilverCard cards with PIC16F876/7 controllers and
24C256/128/64 memory. The package includes a configurator, firmware in several languages, and scripts for reading and writing the phone book and SMS.
